definition.label: Definition
definition.text: Definition: CAS stands for Consolidated Account Statement 📊, issued by CAMS/KFin Technologies. It's a detailed statement that summarizes all your investments linked to your email ID and PAN, covering various financial products like Mutual Funds, Stocks, and other securities.

sections.heading: What is CAS and why do I need it?
items: Track Investments: It helps you see all your investments in one place.
Tax Filing: It's handy for tax filing as it shows your earnings and capital gains.
